hooks.command: F=$(jq -r "(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path) // empty"); [ -n "$F" ] && [ -f "$F" ] && D="$HOME/.claude/backups/$(date +%F)" && mkdir -p "$D" && cp -- "$F" "$D/$(basename -- "$F").$(date +%H%M%S).bak" 2>/dev/null; true

C=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); printf "%s" "$C" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|]|&&) *(sudo +)?rm +(-[a-zA-Z]+ +)*-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]* +(/|~|\\\$HOME)\\*?( |;|$)|(^|[;&|]) *(sudo +)?(dd +if=.* +of=/dev/|mkfs\\.)|:\\(\\)\\{ *:\\|:" && { echo "BLOCKED: destructive command" >&2; exit 2; }; true

{ echo '=== SESSION CONTEXT ==='; echo "host: $(hostname)"; echo "cwd: $(pwd)"; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)"; D=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "modified: $D files"; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo '--- recent commits ---'; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; fi; echo '--- tmux windows ---'; tmux list-windows 2>/dev/null | head -8; PRESERVE=~/.claude/projects/$(echo $PWD | tr / -)/preserve.md; [ -f "$PRESERVE" ] && { echo '--- preserved from prior session ---'; cat "$PRESERVE"; }; true; } 2>&1

S=$HOME/.claude/selfcheck; H=$(cat $S/run.sh $HOME/.claude/settings.json $HOME/.claude/hooks/* $HOME/.claude/agents/*.md 2>/dev/null | cksum); [ "$H" = "$(cat $S/.stamp 2>/dev/null)" ] || { O=$(sh $S/run.sh -q 2>&1) && printf "%s" "$H" > $S/.stamp || { echo "SELFCHECK FAILED — claude setup is broken:"; echo "$O"; }; }; true

F=~/.claude/projects/$(echo $PWD | tr / -)/preserve.md; mkdir -p "$(dirname $F)"; { echo '# Pre-compact preserve'; date; echo; echo '## cwd'; pwd; echo; echo '## modified files'; git status --short 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '## recent commits'; git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null; } > "$F"; true
echo "[$(date)] session-end cwd=$(pwd)" >> ~/.claude/session-log.txt; git status --short >> ~/.claude/session-log.txt 2>/dev/null; true
